title: iPSC PCR for Screening Edited Clones
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8bfrsn
materials: After PCR has been set up, run in thermocycler using the following conditions.
After PCR has been run in thermocycler, it is best to run the sample on a 2% gel to confirm the presence of PCR product.
Blot off excess TBE from cast.

steps.title: Set up 50 µL PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare a PCR mixture totaling 50 µL according to your assay design.

steps.title: Prepare 2 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Combine agarose and TBE in an appropriately sized flask, microwave until the agarose is completely dissolved while swirling intermittently, then add the appropriate amount of ethidium bromide and swirl until evenly dispersed.

steps.title: Pour gel into casting tray
steps.instruction: Transfer the molten agarose solution from the flask into a casting tray, inserting the appropriate number of combs.

steps.title: Allow gel to solidify
steps.instruction: Let the gel sit for 30–40 minutes (or until firm).

steps.title: Place gel in electrophoresis rig
steps.instruction: Insert the solidified gel cast into the gel rig apparatus.

steps.title: Load samples and ladder
steps.instruction: Load PCR samples, including positive and negative controls when possible, and a 50 bp ladder into the wells.

steps.title: Cover gel rig
steps.instruction: Place the lid on the gel rig apparatus.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 150 V for 1 h 30 min, checking at 1 h to ensure samples have not migrated off the gel.

steps.title: Turn off and remove gel
steps.instruction: Switch off the gel rig apparatus and remove the gel cast.

steps.title: Assess PCR product and digest
steps.instruction: If the PCR product shows the appropriate size and concentration on the gel, use the remaining PCR product to perform a restriction digest.
